module: Records the history of played missions (missionId and stars) in playbook.json in the save's career folder. Loaded only when the career is active.
notes: The file is ignored (empty list) if the save's info.json has a version < moduleVersion (42).
The list is never read by this module: it only appends and saves.

addMissionPlayedEntry.desc: Appends {missionId, stars} to the end of the in-memory playbook.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook on extension load: loads the playbook if the career is active (returns false otherwise).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: reloads the playbook when the career becomes active.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes the playbook to <save>/career/playbook.json.
